cama = [3, 8, 26, 76, 225, 298, 258, 233, 189, 128, 68, 29, 14, 4]
N = 763
function sir(u, β, γ)
    contagios = β * u[1] * u[2] / N
    curas = γ * u[2]
    return [-contagios, contagios - curas, curas]
end
function paso(u, h, β, γ)
    k1 = sir(u, β, γ)
    k2 = sir(u + h / 2 * k1, β, γ)
    k3 = sir(u + h / 2 * k2, β, γ)
    k4 = sir(u + h * k3, β, γ)
    return u + h / 6 * (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4)
end
function simula(β, γ, dias)
    u = [N - 1.0, 1.0, 0.0]
    enfermos = Float64[]
    for d in 1:dias
        u = paso(u, 1.0, β, γ)
        push!(enfermos, u[2])
    end
    return enfermos
end
error2(β, γ) = sum((simula(β, γ, 14) .- cama) .^ 2)
βs = [1.3, 1.67, 2.0]
errores = [error2(β, 0.44) for β in βs]
findmin(errores)
